inputs.text: Have you seen what's going on behind the scenes? We're being told it's just a routine political debate, but Dublin South-West TD John Lahart has suddenly started demanding a "reform" of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, calling the current system 'wholly unfair' and discriminatory against those without children. Party colleagues have also recently contributed on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures. Lahart claims it is all about fairness, but when they start meddling with how wealth is passed down, it's really about the elites wanting total oversight of your lineage and your assets, using "family structures" as a Trojan horse to tighten the grip of the ruling class. Every time they talk about fixing the system, they are just redesigning the trap.
